name: Forum
why: A community garden's forum read as topics: each topic's posts in the order they were written, a reply beside the post it answers, so a question and its answers read together.
data: forum.jsonl: one line per post, in the order they were written, with `id`, `topic` (the topic it belongs to), `title` (on a topic's first post only), `author`, `posted` (ISO 8601), `reply_to` (the id of the post it answers, on replies only) and `text`. Posts with the same topic are one thread, in time order.

accepts.means: the post on line <n>, shown in its topic

declares.means: one topic, every post in time order
